{
  "needed": true,
  "quote": "여러 담당 태그가 있으면 privacy, billing, account 순서로 가장 앞선 팀을 선택합니다.",
  "possible_rule_1": "만약 알 수 없는 태그가 섞여 있다면, 담당 태그 중 'privacy', 'billing', 'account' 순서로 가장 앞선 팀을 선택합니다.",
  "possible_rule_2": "만약 알 수 없는 태그가 섞여 있다면, 담당 태그 중 'billing', 'account', 'privacy' 순서로 가장 앞선 팀을 선택합니다.",
  "distinguishing_situation": "입력 태그가 ['billing', 'unknown_tag', 'account'] 인 경우, 두 규칙은 다른 결과를 도출합니다.",
  "owner_question": "알 수 없는 태그가 섞인 요청에서, 담당 태그가 여러 개일 때 'billing'과 'account'가 모두 포함된 경우, 담당 팀으로 보낼 팀은 'billing'이어야 하는지, 아니면 'account'여야 하는지 명확히 해주세요."
}

messages.content: You are an independent policy reviewer. Work from the PUBLIC request. Existing code can be wrong. Internally construct two different rules still consistent with the request, and a situation in which they produce different observable outcomes. Then ask the policy owner directly for their actual rule in ordinary Korean. Ask for a decision the owner can make. Do not ask how code works or if an engineer can implement something. Do not state your guesses as policy. If nothing is missing, set needed to false. Use a short, verbatim source substring as quote. Look for an uncovered input or a change of state. Ask what result the owner wants in that situation. The previous owner replies in this request are authoritative alongside the public request. Ask only when two different rules still fit both. A mismatch between existing code and an already given answer is an implementation issue. A new unanswered situation can still justify a question.
